notes: Very strong corpora: TerminalWorld has three genuine John-the-Ripper cracking tasks (tw_733601/108746/651283) and TMax has a whole family of incident-response password/hash cracking tasks - these are the real signal and dominate final_top10. The RTS shortlist was mostly boilerplate (attack_range_local psec setup, extra-lists node chores, dtool) - discarded; the true RTS matches are the Crackme-Monologix-Linux family (dozens of near-duplicate seeds, I picked distinct ones) plus Bandit/exploitt.py flag-recovery, all found by my own crack/crackme/password searches. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench are genuinely weak here: no offensive password-cracking tasks exist in either, so their picks are crypto/secrets/archive library bug fixes with honest overall 1-3; do not read their low scores as retrieval failure. Merge note: TerminalWorld and RTS crackme seeds overlap heavily (both reference Crackme-Monologix-Linux), so tw_383451 and the rts crackme picks are siblings.
